How do I use it properly the very first time?

10:01 AM
AI agent, Today at 10:01 AM

Absolutely. For the very first use of the C500 Pro, the main thing is to set and test your code before relying on it 👍

Here is the simple first-time setup:

Open the weather cover.
Press the CLEAR button.
Turn the OPEN handle clockwise to open the lid.
Remove the plastic instruction card from the inside of the lid.
With the key safe still open, turn the OPEN handle back to the locked position.
Use the code change tool on the plastic card to choose your code on the back of the lid.
Put the plastic card back.
Test the code several times while the key safe is still open.

A few important tips:

choose a code that is not easy to guess
each number or letter can only be used once
do not use a screwdriver to change the code
the handle must be back in the locked position before changing the code
if you press a wrong button, press CLEAR and start again
on this mechanical model, the code digits can be entered in any order

To use it day to day:

press CLEAR
enter your code
turn OPEN clockwise to open
close the lid and turn OPEN back to relock

These guides walk through it visually:

How to operate the C500 Pro: https://attachments.gorgias.help/RdOkb7oZrBP2VXGN/hc/1QNmd2YYkd29XA0W/2026031911-69c8e32c-4cf9-4e68-be9b-84cc95168c4e-how%20to%20operate%20c500%20pro%20key%20safe.pdf
